title: Book Two · Chapter 46: Inside the Green Cover
story:
On Thursday, a boy waits at the book desk. He holds a new picture book against his chest.

“I brought the green one back yesterday,” he says.

Mei looks through the card box. The other helper checks the next small pile. The green book's card is not there.

“What is on the cover?” Mei asks.

“A goat.”

Ronan looks up from the shelf.

“I put that book away yesterday.”

“Before my check,” Mei says. “I asked you to wait.”

Ronan remembers the open cover. The card was there beside the first page. He closed both together.

“I put it away too early.”

Mei leaves the other cards flat on the desk.

“Can you bring it here?”

Ronan finds the short stories. There are two green covers. One has a tree. The other has the goat.

He takes the goat book out carefully. He does not pull the book beside it onto the floor.

Ronan opens the green book.

The card is still inside. The boy's name is on the last line. There is no return date beside it.

“Here,” Ronan says.

He puts the book and card in front of Mei. She reads the title. The boy points to his name.

“That is me.”

Mei checks the cover, then the first few pages. She writes the return date and puts the card back in the box.

“Now your next book,” she says.

The boy gives her the picture book. He can borrow it now, but most of break is over. He has little time to look at it before the bell.

Ronan keeps his hand on the desk edge.

“I'm sorry I made you wait.”

The boy nods. He takes his book to a seat by the window.

Mei turns toward Ronan.

“I need the card before the book goes back.”

“I know now.”

“Please listen to the whole sentence next time.”

Ronan nods. He lifts the goat book, then pauses.

“Is this one ready for the shelf?”

Mei puts it on the right side of the desk.

“Yes. This side.”

He carries it back. This time he checks the front cover first. There is no card inside.

Later, Jun brings a book to the desk. He puts it on the left and gives his name to Mei.

Ronan waits beside the shelf. He has three books ready for that space. Jun's book must wait for its check.

Jun sees Ronan waiting.

“You can take mine after Mei checks it.”

“Yes.”

The bell goes. The book corner closes for the lesson. Miss Wu lets Mei finish the last card, then sends the helpers to their seats.

Jun passes the checked book to Ronan. They put it in the space together. The book fits. The other books stay upright.

“Ready,” Jun says.

Ronan agrees. The card box stays on the desk. Ronan goes back with Jun. Their school books are waiting. He opens to the lesson page and moves his pencil away from Jun's elbow.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

card＝借阅卡；inside＝在里面；title＝书名；early＝过早。

## 理解问题

1. 为什么男孩暂时不能借下一本书？
2. Ronan怎样找到卡片，并说明自己的失误？

## 读句子

**Ronan / opens / the green book.** Ronan／打开／绿书。
